private static final class SshClientTheme.SapphireCheck extends Object implements Icon

  • Method Details

    • paintIcon

      public void paintIcon(Component c, Graphics g, int x, int y)
      The paintIcon method draws the check outline and the mark. Antialiasing is turned on. The outline is inset by one pixel. The outline size is eleven pixels. An unselected component draws no mark. A component that is not a button draws no mark. A selected button draws the emerald mark. The stroke width is two pixels. The cap and the join are round. The mark runs through three points. Those points are offset by three and seven, six and eleven, and eleven and four. The graphics copy is disposed.
      Specified by:
      paintIcon in interface Icon
      Parameters:
      c - The check box.
      g - The graphics context.
      x - The left edge.
      y - The top edge.
